description: Returns the unsigned calls that create a block (a B20 token with an engraved face and a brain) AND open its market, paired with ETH or with one of the currencies from tblock_pairs: createPaid, approvals, registration, market opening — to be signed in order by `account`. Fee: 0.001 ETH. The response lists every cost (`cout`), the block address, and the result of simulating the whole sequence from that wallet. For a non-ETH pair the wallet must already hold the creator minimum in that currency.

account.description: The wallet that will sign; it receives the whole supply and becomes the creator.

pair.description: ETH (default) or the address of a currency from tblock_pairs.

salt.description: Optional free text that fixes the block address. Generated when absent; send it again to get the same plan.

name: tblock_plan_birth
title: Plan the birth of a block
